We propose a novel PDA approach by exploring the implicit semantic topics of visual features to align source and target domains.

1) the proposed Implicit Semantic Response Alignment is an effective method to address the Partial Domain Adaptation problem; 2) the implicit semantic topics can be extracted from the visual features to capture the intrinsic relationship among different categories; 3) the implicit semantic response alignment can be applied on the feature level instead of sample level to retain more relevant information contained in extra categories.
